title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent finds tool-permission bypass in Open WebUI
summary: Open WebUI v0.6.43 chat completion accepts caller-supplied tool IDs/servers without checking the user’s permission; server-held credentials may then invoke restricted tools with server privileges.
ai_role: GHSL credits an AI agent it developed, reviewed by Man Yue Mo and Peter Stöckli. GHSL records the report on 2026-01-05 and links the vendor advisory.
classification_note: The public advisory documents the vulnerability and disclosure/remediation status. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The vendor advisory reports local tool access fixed in v0.7.0 and the MCP server path fixed in v0.8.6; users on v0.8.6 or later are not affected.
